meta.title: Room to Breathe, a Community to Grow In
meta.description: Gereja Kristen Jakarta Jemaat Tangerang — services every Sunday morning and Saturday evening. Open to families, young adults, and anyone arriving for the first time.

hero.standfirst: In a city that never stops moving, there is one room built deliberately slow. The doors open every Sunday morning — including for you, arriving with nothing in hand.
hero.posterAlt: The empty sanctuary at GKJ Tangerang, looking down the centre aisle toward the cross

vision.label: Why we gather
vision.verse: I rejoiced with those who said to me, “Let us go to the house of the Lord.”
vision.statement: To proclaim the grace of salvation and to mature the congregation in God's love, power, and truth.
vision.body: We are not a church that promises a life without trouble. We believe in a grace larger than the trouble — and in a community willing to walk it with you, week after week, without rushing the process.

liturgy.label: The Sunday experience
liturgy.title: What actually happens in those two hours
liturgy.lead: For most people the hardest part of walking into a church is not belief — it is not knowing what is about to happen. So here it is, in order, with nothing oversold.
liturgy.hint: Scroll, click a number, or use the arrow keys

arrival.title: Arrival & the Walkway
arrival.body: There is no welcome desk and no form to fill in. There is coffee on the walkway, and usually someone says hello before you have to introduce yourself.
arrival.note: Arriving late is fine too. The side door stays open through the whole service.

worship.title: Music & Reflection
worship.body: A few songs together, then a silence long enough to actually feel. Nobody will ask you to raise your hands, and nobody notices if you stay seated.
worship.note: Lyrics go up on the screens. You do not need to know the songs.

word.title: Scripture & Teaching
word.body: One passage read aloud, then explained — with its context, with honesty about the difficult parts, and with a real connection to life in Tangerang on Monday morning.
word.note: Bibles sit in every row. You do not need to bring one.

table.title: The Table
table.body: Communion is served on dates announced in advance. Bread and cup are passed along the row; you are free to receive or to let them pass without explaining anything.
table.note: Nobody keeps a record of who took part.

life.title: Life Together
life.body: This is the part people skip most often, and it matters most. A second coffee, unplanned conversation, and small groups meeting in homes through the week.
life.note: You are also free to go straight home. We often do.

firstTime.title: The questions people rarely get to ask

dress.a: Whatever you are comfortable in. On any given Sunday you will see batik, button-downs, t-shirts and sandals in the same room. Nobody is counting.

kids.a: Sunday School runs alongside Morning Service II at 10am. Walk your child to the Sunday School room, write your name and mobile number on the pickup sheet, and collect them with the same numbered card. Babies and toddlers are welcome to stay with you in the sanctuary.

parking.a: The church yard takes both cars and motorbikes, and an attendant directs traffic during service hours. If the yard is full, the shoulder in front of the church is normally used — the attendant will show you where.

facilities.a: Restrooms are off the walkway, near the café. The sanctuary is on the ground floor and step-free for wheelchair access. For a nursing room or any other need, mention it to someone at the door and it will be arranged.

late.a: Just come in. The side door by the walkway stays open through the service, and the back rows are deliberately kept free for exactly this.

language.q: What language is the service in?
language.a: Indonesian. Some songs are in English, and this site is available in both languages. If you need language support, message the secretariat ahead of time.

sermon.label: Room & Sound
sermon.title: Ten seconds before anyone arrives
sermon.lead: This is a recording of our own sanctuary, captured empty. Play it while you read the order of service — so your first Sunday does not feel like walking into an unfamiliar room.
sermon.waveform: Waveform of the sanctuary room tone
sermon.note: A recording of the room, not of a service.
sermon.teachingLead: Not a motivational talk, and not a theology lecture. One passage of Scripture, read in its context, explained until it is clear, then carried into the actual decisions of that week.
sermon.watchBody: Footage of the sanctuary, from the centre aisle toward the pulpit.
sermon.archiveNote: Sermon recordings and daily devotionals are available in the Member Portal.

schedule.label: Times & Location
schedule.title: Five gatherings a week, and one seat still empty
schedule.lead: The two morning services carry the same content — only the number of people in the room changes. The rest keep a rhythm of their own.
schedule.livestreamFallback: Ask the secretariat for the stream link
schedule.parkingBody: On-site yard, with an attendant during service hours.

nextgen.label: Sunday School & Youth
nextgen.title: Your child is not parked. They are taught.
nextgen.lead: Sunday School runs alongside Morning Service II at 10am on a curriculum that progresses through the year — not an activity to fill the time until their parents are done.

safety.title: Recorded pickup
safety.body: Every child is dropped off and collected against the same numbered card. Children are released only to the card holder.

curriculum.title: A curriculum that progresses
curriculum.body: One arc through the Bible across the year, split by age group, so children are not hearing the same story on repeat with no direction.

teachers.title: The same teachers
teachers.body: Teachers and helpers serve in fixed groups, so children come to know the adults who teach them.

youth.title: Youth & students
youth.body: A Saturday evening service in a format more open to questions, continuing in small groups through the week.

nextgen.waMessage: Good morning, I would like to ask about Sunday School at {church}.

mission.label: How we work
mission.expansion: Unity · Worship and Prayer · Small Groups · Discipleship · Evangelism · Social Service
mission.lead: Six commitments that decide where this congregation's time, energy and money go.
mission.item2: Guide every member into intimacy with God through worship and prayer.
mission.item3: Shepherd the congregation through small groups.
mission.item4: Train and equip the congregation through continuous discipleship.
mission.item5: Ignite the congregation's passion to proclaim the grace of salvation.
mission.item6: Carry out social service in love.

footer.faithBody: We confess the Bible as the written word of God, the sole foundation of the congregation's faith and life; and Jesus Christ as Lord and Saviour, by grace, through faith.

stories.label: Stories
stories.title: Four generations, one room, every Sunday.
stories.lead: A grandmother who knows every hymn by heart, a toddler still learning to sit still, and a student who came alone last week — all in the same row of chairs.
